reason: My customers find me on Glovo and by walking past, nobody complains about the old site. 25 euro every month for something I have ignored for years is money I would rather keep for milk and beans.
objection: I don't trust a robot reading my chalkboard photo. If it puts cappuccino at 2.30 instead of 3.20 on Google and someone argues at the counter, that is my problem, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbouring café owner I know showing me it on their phone for a couple of months with no mistakes, and a free first month so I can see if anyone actually looks at the site.
